title: Stolen Legos Leads to Bomb Found During Traffic Stop
description:
On January 24, 2022, Walmart notified police of a woman that had stolen Legos worth nearly $300 in Broken Arrow, OK. An officer happened to spot the woman’s vehicle and conducted a traffic stop. During the traffic stop, the officer noticed the stolen Legos in the backseat along with what appeared to be an explosive device.

For business inquiries or other questions contact:
codebluecam@gmail.com

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
